title: In this world, you're trapped inside an "In this world" video.
formula: Strange act (punching the edge of the screen) -> why (you live inside a looping 'In this world' video; loop 9,000) -> doubter (Gary the extra: nobody leaves before the end) -> opponent with total power (the narrator: whatever follows 'In this world' comes true) -> the rule used against you (painted doors, soup shoes) -> weird preparation, mystery protected (every loop you jump and grab something; a jar you guard; Gary's ladder timed to the frame) -> setback (the narrator notices and freezes you) -> tension stretch (the progress bar 90-99 %) -> the doubter's habit saves you (his ladder clips the jar) -> the narrator's own power frees you (he reads his captions aloud) -> twist: you escape into the next video, loop 1
loop: Line 1: you're punching the edge of the screen on loop 9,000. Last: you escape into the next video, loop 1, and raise your fist at its edge: the punch starts again.
facts: Fiction: no sources needed. Rule: you are a character inside a Stickrified 'In this world' Short. When the progress bar reaches the end, the video loops and you start again. The narrator is the villain: anything he says after the words 'In this world' becomes true. He also reads his captions aloud, whatever they say.
Planted early (visible oddities): a caption with a word missing (line 10), the glowing jar you guard (line 11), Gary walking the exact same path every loop (lines 4-5).

lines.narration: You're punching the edge of the *screen*.
lines.scene: Cold open, MCU: your fist slams into the edge of the frame itself; the whole picture wobbles like jelly and a crack spiders across the corner. Face: angry -> scheming. At ~1 s, hard cut down to the red progress bar along the bottom of the frame, already filling: the threat.
lines.camera: Punch-in on the fist hitting the frame edge, hard cut to the progress bar
lines.gag: The frame edge ripples like glass where you hit it

lines.narration: Because you're stuck inside an "In this world" video, and when it ends, it *loops*.
lines.spoken: Because you're stuck inside an 'In this world' video, and when it ends... it loops.
lines.scene: The progress bar hits the end; the whole street rewinds with tape wobble, birds flying backwards, and you snap back to mid-punch. Face: shocked -> crying (tears).
lines.camera: Wide on the street as it rewinds, whip back to your face
lines.gag: The whole street rewinds, birds flying backwards

lines.narration: This is loop *9,000*.
lines.scene: A wall covered floor to roof in chalk tally marks; you add one more and the chalk snaps. Face: tired -> deadpan.
lines.camera: Slow pull-out along the wall of tally marks
lines.gag: The chalk snaps on mark 9,000

lines.narration: Gary, the extra who walks by with a ladder every loop, gave up *years* ago.
lines.scene: Gary (overalls, a long ladder on his shoulder, a mug that says WORLD'S OKAYEST EXTRA) strolls the exact same line as always; two grooves are worn into the cobbles by his feet. You run beside him, pleading.
lines.camera: Tracking side-on with Gary, ladder sweeping past the lens
lines.gag: Gary's footsteps have worn grooves into the cobbles

lines.narration: "Nobody leaves before the end, kid," he says, for the 9,000th *time*.
lines.spoken: "Nobody leaves before the end, kid," he says, for the nine thousandth time.
lines.scene: Gary says it without even looking at you; you mouth every word along with him, in perfect sync. Faces: Gary deadpan; you disgusted -> deadpan.
lines.camera: Two-shot, slow push
lines.gag: You mouth his line along with him, word for word

lines.narration: And nobody beats the narrator. That's *me*.
lines.scene: The sky dims; the caption bar at the bottom of the frame glows and swells up into a giant floating sign that towers over the street. Your face: nervous, sweat drop.
lines.camera: Low angle, tilt up as the caption sign rises
lines.gag: The narrator's caption bar towers over you like a billboard

lines.narration: Whatever I say after "In this world" comes *true*.
lines.scene: The giant caption sign hangs over the street, the words IN THIS WORLD glowing; the street seems to hold its breath.
lines.camera: Slow crane around the sign

lines.narration: In this world, every door is painted *on*.
lines.scene: You sprint at a shop door and smack flat into it: it's a painting. You slide down it. Face: determined -> ring eyes -> crying.
lines.camera: Follow you into the door, hard cut on the splat
lines.gag: The door is a painting; you slide down it

lines.narration: In this world, your shoes are full of *soup*.
lines.scene: Squelch: you lift a sneaker and tomato soup sloshes out. Behind you, Gary sips from his mug: it's soup too. Face: disgusted.
lines.camera: Low insert on the shoe, tilt up to your face
lines.gag: Gary's mug is full of soup too

lines.narration: So every loop, at the same second, you jump and *grab* something.
lines.scene: You leap at the captions along the bottom of the frame and snatch one glowing word; that caption now has a gap where a word should be. Face: scheming.
lines.camera: Low angle, the jump framed against the caption bar
lines.gag: A caption on screen is missing a word

lines.narration: You hide it in a jar under your bed, and you never let Gary *near* it.
lines.scene: Night bedroom: a glass jar under the bed glowing with stolen words. Gary leans in through the window with his ladder and reaches for it; you slap his hand away. Faces: you suspicious; Gary pleading.
lines.camera: Under-bed POV on the jar, then two-shot
lines.gag: You slap Gary's hand away from the jar

lines.narration: And you've timed his ladder, to the frame, 9,000 *times*.
lines.spoken: And you've timed his ladder, to the frame, nine thousand times.
lines.scene: Your wall of tally marks now has chalk diagrams of Gary's path, a stopwatch and string between pins. Face: proud.
lines.camera: Pan across the chalk plan
lines.gag: A stopwatch hangs on a nail labelled GARY

lines.narration: A word a loop, 9,000 loops, and today you need just *one* more.
lines.spoken: A word a loop, nine thousand loops, and today you need just one more.
lines.scene: Back on the street, the next caption slides along the bottom of the frame; you crouch under it, eyes locked on one word, jar ready. Face: excited -> scheming.
lines.camera: Low angle, push in on your eyes
lines.gag: You crouch like a cat under the captions

lines.narration: Then, this loop, I *notice*.
lines.scene: The giant caption sign turns toward you like an eye; you stop mid-step on the street, the jar under your arm. Face: nervous, sweat.
lines.camera: Fast push-in on you from behind the sign
lines.gag: The caption sign turns to look at you

lines.narration: In this world, you can't *move*.
lines.scene: You freeze grey and stiff like a statue mid-run, jar in hand; only your eyes can still move, darting. Face: pinpoint eyes.
lines.camera: Slow arc around the frozen you
lines.gag: Only your eyes can still move

lines.narration: The red bar crawls. 90%. 95%. *99*.
lines.spoken: The red bar crawls. Ninety percent. Ninety-five. Ninety-nine.
lines.scene: The progress bar inches toward the end; your eyes dart to it and back; behind you, Gary's ladder swings into frame on his usual path.
lines.camera: Hard cuts between the bar and your eyes

lines.narration: But Gary is right on time, and his ladder clips your *jar*.
lines.scene: Gary walks his exact line; the ladder swings round and knocks the jar out of your frozen hand; glass bursts and the glowing words spill out and drop into the caption bar. Faces: Gary shocked; you excited.
lines.camera: Low angle, slow motion on the jar
lines.gag: The words spill out and fall into the caption bar

lines.narration: They land in my captions, and I read captions out loud. I can't *help* it.
lines.scene: The stolen words click into the caption bar one by one: IN / THIS / WORLD / YOU'RE / FREE. The giant sign shakes.
lines.camera: Insert on the caption bar filling
lines.gag: The words click into place like tiles

lines.narration: "In this world... you're... *free*."
lines.scene: The edge of the frame shatters like a windscreen; light pours in; colour floods back into you and you unfreeze. Gary drops his mug. Face: shocked -> excited.
lines.camera: Push in as the frame edge shatters
lines.gag: The frame edge shatters like glass

lines.narration: 9,000 loops, because I almost never say *free*.
lines.spoken: Nine thousand loops, because I almost never say free.
lines.scene: The empty jar rolls across the cobbles; its label reads 'FREE: 1'. The giant caption sign sags like a sulking face.
lines.camera: Insert on the jar label
lines.gag: The caption sign sulks

lines.narration: You dive straight through the crack and out of the *video*.
lines.scene: You dive through the broken frame edge in slow motion, grinning; Gary waves goodbye with his empty mug. Face: excited, blush.
lines.camera: Follow the dive through the crack
lines.gag: Gary waves goodbye with his mug

lines.narration: Into the next one. Loop *one*.
lines.scene: You land in a brand-new 'In this world' video: a pink street where everyone is a pigeon, a fresh red progress bar starting at zero, and a pigeon with a tiny ladder walking by. Face: crying -> scheming; you raise your fist at the edge of the screen.
lines.camera: Hold on you, tiny push as the fist comes up
lines.gag: The next video's Gary is a pigeon with a tiny ladder
